notes.title: Welcome to The Hideaway !
notes.content:
[h2]The Hideaway : Chapter 1 playtest just opened ![/h2]

[h3]First of all, I want to thank you for downloading the playtest and for playing the game, even after nearly two years of inactivity on Steam![/h3]

I kept working on the game during that time, listening to your feedback — the good and the bad — and trying to turn the project into something truly special. What you're about to experience now marks a new way for me to develop the game: from now on, I'll be publishing one to two patches per week. I'll do my best to implement all the planned features, fix bugs and issues, and shape the game into something that reflects [b]YOUR[/b] vision.

[h3]Here's a simple illustration showing the playtest roadmap:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598900/05678d579b35a956ea3e816a6d722ddb15b41ce7.png[/img]

[h2]We're officially starting Step 2 now![/h2]

For more than a month straight, I'll be reading, listening to, and replying to every single one of your comments. I'll patch as many bugs as possible, and I’ll also be running polls on the official Discord server about some new (and existing) mechanics and visual effects — so that together, we can shape and evolve the game.

[b]Today marks the start of a new adventure — a gaming adventure between you and me![/b]

Please keep in mind that I'm not a professional game developer; I'm working on this project almost entirely solo during my free time. So yes, you might (and probably will) encounter bugs, issues, and crashes while playing the playtest — especially because I'm trying to innovate on some technical concepts and aiming to create a high-quality, artistic indie experience! ^^

If you’re not yet part of the Discord server, I warmly invite you to join! I'm building a small community of passionate gamers who are excited about having a real say in the development of The Hideaway.

Here’s the link: https://discord.gg/VhjCYcbh8p

I know the community has been a bit inactive lately, but I'm really eager to bring it back to life!

Thank you again for reading this announcement all the way to the end, thank you for being part of the community — and see you in a few days for the first official patch notes! ^^
